image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a sliced meatloaf resting in a crinkled aluminum foil pan. The loaf is oblong and has been cut into approximately six thick slices. It features a dark brown, textured exterior coated with a glossy, deep red glaze (likely ketchup or tomato-based). The interior of the slices shows a dense, ground meat texture with visible lighter flecks, consistent with onions or breadcrumbs. The lighting creates strong specular highlights on the glaze.
